relations.statement: IsLicensedLiftCandidate L holds iff all required evidence fields of L are true

lemmas.statement: A licensed lift candidate has a passing host replay, so a candidate without replay is not a licensed lift.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem licensed_needs_replay (L : OmegaCore.PrimitiveLiftCandidate.LiftCandidate) : OmegaCore.PrimitiveLiftCandidate.IsLicensedLiftCandidate L → L.hasReplay = true := OmegaCore.PrimitiveLiftCandidate.licensed_lift_requires_replay L

lemmas.statement: A licensed lift candidate has a source obstruction.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem licensed_needs_obs (L : OmegaCore.PrimitiveLiftCandidate.LiftCandidate) : OmegaCore.PrimitiveLiftCandidate.IsLicensedLiftCandidate L → L.hasSourceObstruction = true := OmegaCore.PrimitiveLiftCandidate.licensed_lift_requires_source_obstruction L

near_misses.claim: A PASS LiftReceipt from evaluate_two_boxed_laws_gate is a licensed lift.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The receipt consumes supplied flags and is only a candidate check; licensing requires a verified retraction and host replay.

near_misses.claim: A declared successor atlas row proves its successor rationale.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The rationale stays unproved until an accepted lift record is attested; declared successor is not candidate lift is not licensed lift.
